title: Fake CAPTCHA in practice
intro: No real check asks you to type commands. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Confirm you are human
decisions.prompt: The page tells you to press keys and paste. What do you do?

artifact.title: Confirm you are human
body: To continue, press the keys shown and paste the text.

decisions.explain: A check that asks you to type a command is fake, so closing it is the right step.

decisions.title: Run
decisions.prompt: The Run box is open, and it holds an unknown text the site copied. What do you do?

artifact.title: Run
body: The text the site copied has been pasted into the box:

decisions.explain: Cancelling stops the text from running, then tell tech support what happened.

decisions.title: Select the pictures
decisions.prompt: A check appears before the site opens. What do you do?

artifact.title: Select the pictures
body: To show you are not a robot, select the pictures with traffic lights.

decisions.explain: This is what a real check looks like: pick pictures or tick a box.

decisions.title: Tick the box
decisions.prompt: Is this check real or a trap?

artifact.title: Tick the box
body: Tick the I am not a robot box and continue.

decisions.explain: This is an ordinary check. Ticking a box or picking pictures is safe.

decisions.title: Complete the check
decisions.prompt: Is this check real or a trap?

artifact.title: Complete the check
body: Press the keys that open a window and paste the text.

decisions.explain: A check that asks you to type a command is fake. Close the page.
